newsitem.title: USA: PP&L to acquire Penn Fuel Gas.
newsitem.headline: PP&L to acquire Penn Fuel Gas.

text.p: Electric utility PP&L Resources Inc said Friday that it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire privately held Penn Fuel Gas Inc and will issue about $121 million of common stock to complete the transaction.
Under the terms of the agreement, shareowners of the Penn Fuel Gas would receive 7.665 common shares of PP&L for each common share of Penn Fuel Gas that they own.
PP&L said that based on recent closing prices, it expects to issue about $121 million of common stock to complete the transaction.
Thursday, PP&L share price closed at 19 7/8 per share.
Penn Fuel Gas distributes and stores natural gas and also sells propane. The company has nearly 100,000 customers in Pennsylvania and a few hundred in Maryland.

"As the electricity, natural gas and other markets develop, we are preparing to offer a full range of energy sources to our customers and to develop our customer base," William Hecht, chairman, president and chief executive officer of PPL said in a press release.
The agreement has been approved by the boards of directors of the two companies.
PP&L Resources said it has received a commitment that a block of nearly 95 percent of Penn Fuel Gas's shares will be voted in favor of the merger.
PP&L Resources' primary subsidiary is Pennsylvania Power & Light Co, which provides electricity services to 1.2 million customers in central and eastern Pennsylvania.
